prompt:
Contemporary figurative oil painting of one ordinary person, full-length figure, isolated as a clean cut-out on a fully transparent background: no background, no floor, no cast shadow, no frame, no text, no logos.

Subject: a Chinese-American man in his late 50s standing in a relaxed, natural pose, reading an open hardcover book held in both hands. Reading glasses low on his nose, neatly cut salt-and-pepper hair, a heather-grey cardigan over a crisp white shirt, dark charcoal trousers, brown leather shoes, a pencil tucked behind one ear. His weight rests on one leg and he has the hint of a curious, engaged smile, as if he just found the answer he was looking for. The book pages are blank or unreadable.

Style: confident, loose, painterly brushwork with visible strokes in the clothing folds; rich, luminous color; soft natural daylight from the left; warm, true skin tones; a dignified, warm, quietly joyful mood, like a portrait in a modern gallery. Realistic proportions and a natural, unposed gesture. The painted edges of the figure are crisp enough to sit on a solid color page.
